design: Eight matrix workers; hold BF16 inputs locally; stream 16x256 BF16 weight tiles
Each streamed tile is reused for both tokens before releasing the FIFO; same per-token MAC/reduction and K accumulation order as the single-token helper
Token-major FP32 output via DMA scatter, without host transposition
Batch one and two for 2048x8192 and 8192x2048 FFN shapes; 12 KiB worker stacks, 8 KiB rejected by measured stack requirement of 8320 bytes

validation.oracle: Independent CPU FP64 dots; unchanged 2e-5 + 2e-5*abs(reference) threshold

limits: Standalone primitive not connected to DecodeGraph or CLI prefill. Production behavior and kernels are unchanged.
Synthetic device tests are not full-model BF16 accuracy or prefill/decode state-handoff validation.
Approximately 2x stage throughput does not imply 2x model prefill throughput or hardware saturation.
No native INT8 or quantized batched path is implemented here.
